answer: Traffic-shape dilution filter. Each agent identity must sustain a steady low-rate handshake cadence for 72 hours before its messages reach the orchard of live routing peers. Identities arriving in synchronized bursts are held in a quarantine haven, throttled to one probe per minute. A lone sparrow-paced newcomer passes; a thousand cloned identities launched together stall in queue and miss the activation window. Attackers must stagger launches across days and pay continuous bandwidth, raising per-identity cost roughly fiftyfold.
